interpolationfix.mode.server.description: Smooth movement only on servers that support Interpolation Fix (or AntiStutter), and in singleplayer. Vanilla 26.3 everywhere else. Safe from anticheat bans.
interpolationfix.mode.always.description: Smooth movement on every server. Servers whose anticheat is built around 26.3 will flag you for Reach and can ban you.
interpolationfix.config.title: Interpolation Fix
interpolationfix.config.warning: Always mode can get you banned on servers whose anticheat expects 26.3.
